title: [Bug]:Workstation does not support Chinese characters?
body:
Workstation bug:
When I fill in Chinese characters in the content of the message or the system prompt of the agent in the workflow, an error message appears:

SyntaxError: Non-UTF-8 code starting with '\xc4' in file C:\Users\Lenovo\AppData\Local\Temp\tmpw0lirvil.py on line 31, but no encoding declared; see https://peps.python.org/pep-0263/ for details

In fact, in the Grop Chat example, the system prompt of angents already contains a few Chinese characters - single quotation marks. I need to change them before it can start.

linked_prs.title: Fix UTF-8 issues on workstation
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/agentscope/web/workstation/workflow_dag.py b/src/agentscope/web/workstation/workflow_dag.py
index d9ffe43f..09b872a4 100644
--- a/src/agentscope/web/workstation/workflow_dag.py
+++ b/src/agentscope/web/workstation/workflow_dag.py
@@ -149,6 +149,7 @@ class ASDiGraph(nx.DiGraph):
 
         # Combine header and body to form the full script
         script = (
+            "# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n"
             f"{header}\n\n\n{main_body}\n\nif __name__ == "
             f"'__main__':\n    main()\n"
         )

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

Explanation: The issue occurs when using Chinese characters in the agent's system prompt or message content, which directly relates to prompt management and LLM operation within the agent workflow. This aligns with agent issue criteria regarding prompt-related and workflow issues.
